question.text: Stamp duty on ETIRD contract notes is payable by:

answer.text: No stamp duty applies to ETIRD

explanation.text: The Logic: Trading charges, including stamp duty on exchange-traded interest rate derivative (ETIRD) contract notes, are payable/recoverable from the client. Under the pan-India mechanism, stamp duty on IRD trades is levied at 0.0001% and is applicable on the buyer. Stock exchanges/clearing corporations collect it from members, and members in turn collect it from the client. The Trap: While the exchange or broker administers the collection, the economic liability falls on the client (buyer). Stamp duty does apply to ETIRD -- it is not exempt. Note: Workbook reference: NISM Series IV pp.222-224. The rate is uniform across India under the current mechanism and is applicable on the buyer, not the seller.
